title: Fast Home Command MC
description: This Mod allows player to teleport to home or world spawn point using /home command
body:
Fast Home Command is a lightweight mod that brings back the functionality of the old /home command from early Minecraft versions (Java Edition Alpha). Unlike its historical predecessor, which only teleported players to the world spawn, this mod sends you to your personal spawn point set by a bed or the /spawnpoint command, with automatic cross-dimensional teleportation.

**A Piece of Minecraft History**
The original /home command was added in Java Edition Alpha v1.0.16 and removed in v1.2.5. Back then, beds didn't set individual spawn points, so the command simply teleported the player to the world spawn. This mod revives the idea of a simple "go home" command while adapting it to modern game mechanics.
